The Prisoner

Feyruz's fiancée Aliya was caught stealing and is imprisoned in the small fortress in the Necromancers' Desert. She will soon be moved to a much better guarded prison. Feyruz asks his friends to rescue her before then. It will be a dangerous job...

Objectives

Kill the sentry

Open the gates

Fight your way into the prison

Escape

Locations

Maps
Necromancers' desert

PropertyValue
